stages.description: Lead enters via web form, phone, quote builder, AI planner, or referral
stages.responseTarget: Within 4 business hours for all priority 1 and 2 leads

stages.description: Confirm project scope, budget indicator, timeline, and decision-makers
Deeper understanding of workplace needs, aesthetic preferences, constraints
stages.best: Face-to-face at Brisbane showroom or video call with screen share of product range

stages.presentationNote: Always present top tier first. Walk client down if needed — never walk up.

stages.description: Address objections, progress to order confirmation

objectionHandling.tooExpensive: Reframe around TCO — 6-year warranty vs replacing at 2–3 years. Calculate the cost difference.
objectionHandling.needMoreTime: Ask who else needs to be involved. Offer to present to CFO or decision-maker directly.
objectionHandling.lookingAtOthers: Send a comparison framework. Emphasise warranty, service, installation, and project certainty.

stages.milestone: Project begins from order confirmation date

stages.description: Project delivered, installed, handed over with warranty documentation

highValueSalesBehaviours: Bring clients to the showroom for projects above $50,000 — highest conversion activity
Present 3 tiers — always start from the top
Equip the internal champion (Office Manager/EA) with everything they need to sell internally
Be first with a quote — sets the reference price for the whole evaluation
Send sample kits proactively — fabric/finish stalls 80% of projects
Use silence after presenting final pricing — never fill the pause
commonSalesMistakes: Starting price conversation before establishing value
Presenting one option instead of 3 tiers
Discounting immediately when price is questioned
Quoting individual items without bundling complementary products
Not identifying the internal champion early
Missing the decision-maker — talking only to the researcher
Failing to create legitimate urgency around lead times and installation slots

budgetCycles.campaignAdvice: Pitch hard into Q4 and Q1. Run targeted campaigns August–September to capture companies with fresh budgets.
budgetCycles.governmentBudget: Government EOFY June — pitch April–May for budget inclusion
